tie_rule: maximize solved count; ties choose lower pair index; reject API/parser errors, campaign stage guard, replay mismatch, or >=75% early local-limit stops
scope: Exploratory 12x12x4 validation only; first two complete scale_validation boards, seed 11, identical B=128 and all per-run resource limits for each method and pair; no 32x32 solver calls.
generation_cap_semantics: Counts each logical generator API call, including cache hits and retries; each request asks for at most num_subgoals=2 boards.
budget_choice_rule: B*=256 is the first preset >= 1.2 times max known 12x12 scale-validation witness length 107; confirm on validation and cost before freeze. Known witness lengths are not minimal.
